name: socket-drop-client
description: Drop every socket, client side: the simulator closes all of its agent WebSockets at once, with no close frame, and every agent redials on the shipped agent's reconnect pacing (W09: a stable socket waits U(1 s, 30 s); the --pre-w09-fraction cohort waits U(1 s, 5 s)). Exercises only the socket path; HTTP keep-alives and in-flight requests are untouched.
